summary:
V6.2 backend fully green (15/15). Delta-Drop CRUD (publish/list/get/apply/defer + permissions + clone-only-apply + idempotent dedup) all pass; character rules validator + dual approval (app-internal + GM ratification with house-rules bypass) all pass; session seat-take 409 gate + GM force=true override verified. V6.1 regression pass retained (seed-evereantha-suite 9 motives, pulse motive resolver returns Lyra/Luminar/Kin).

Frontend source-verified: CharacterApprovalPanel.jsx and DeltaDropPanel.jsx both ship the required data-testids (delta-drop-panel, delta-publish-form, delta-publish-title-input, delta-publish-btn, delta-preview-modal, delta-preview-counts, character-approval-panel, approval-status-badge, approval-breakdown, approval-run-validator-btn, approval-gm-approve-btn, approval-gm-note-input, approval-gm-revoke-btn, approval-house-rules-badge, approval-issues, approval-warnings). Playwright login worked (landed at /app) but campaign tile clicks didn't expose /app/campaigns/{id} hrefs in the first 30 DOM anchors — tiles likely render as onClick handlers rather than <a>. Could not automate the deep drill-into-tab-delta in the time budget (loop-prevention triggered). Main agent can self-verify via manual click-through; all testids are confirmed present in source.

smoke_limitations.flow: Deep UI automation into DeltaDropPanel + CharacterApprovalPanel
smoke_limitations.issue: Campaign tiles on /app/campaigns do not expose /app/campaigns/{id} anchors in the DOM (onClick-based navigation), so Playwright href scraping didn't yield a specific campaign URL within the time budget. Source review confirms all required data-testids are wired. Main agent can self-verify by manually opening a campaign → Delta Drop tab.

action_items: (Optional) Add a data-testid like 'campaign-tile-{id}' on the campaign list tile anchor so future automation can drill in without scraping onClick handlers.

V6.2 is ready to ship on backend; recommend the main agent manually click through (a) campaign → Delta Drop tab (origin publishes, clone applies/defers) and (b) a character sheet → Character Approval panel (validator, GM approve) to visually confirm layout/copy.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/deltas.py:apply_delta correctly dedupes nodes by title (set existing_node_titles) and motives by (node_id, motive) tuple — confirmed idempotent: second apply added 0 new nodes in test. Non-destructive epic/genesis apply (only if clone is empty or un-refined) is correct per spec.

routes/character_validation.py:_validate_character is clean — BESM CP sum (stats×2 above baseline + attrs×level − defect refunds + skills×level − character defects), Anime 5E point-buy budget, D&D level 1-20, Cypher tier 1-6. gm_approve_for_play correctly blocks HTTP 400 when !passes_rules AND no house_rules (verified). House-rule set allows GM to override app-internal gate (verified).
routes/sessions.py:seat_character V6.2 gate correctly returns 409 for un-approved characters and honours force=true for GM (both verified). Good UX: error message tells user what to do.
DeltaDropPanel.jsx uses window.alert() for apply result summary — consider replacing with a toast/inline panel for consistency with the rest of the app UI (minor UX polish, not a bug).

success_rate.frontend: Source-verified PASS — all required data-testids present; deep DOM automation limited by tile onClick nav pattern

test_credentials: GMFran admin franpietrowski@gmail.com / PieGod08!! works (brute-force lockout still 5 fails / 15 min).
seed_data_creation: POST /api/admin/seed-evereantha-suite is called at test-suite start; tests create TEST_ prefixed deltas, TEST_v62_validate character, TEST_seat session. New clone via POST /api/campaigns/{origin}/clone each run.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend V6.2 is green. If main agent wants deep Playwright, add data-testid='campaign-tile-{id}' on the CampaignList tile element so automation can find a specific campaign href. All other UI testids for V6.2 (delta-drop-panel, delta-publish-*, character-approval-panel, approval-*) are already in place.
rca of the issue: No bugs found in V6.2 backend implementation. Two minor test authoring fixes during iteration: (a) clone response returns {campaign:{id:...}} not {id:...} — test adapted. (b) Campaign edits go via PUT (full CampaignIn body), not PATCH — test helper _set_house_rules now GETs+mutates+PUTs.
